title: The Alley cabaret behind Seminard Market
summary: Purnell clarifies the Alley was at St. Bernard and Claiborne behind the market, not in Storyville, where he heard Guy Kelly.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Did they have any bands up in the district there say along the Basin or Ivoryville? Yeah, they had bands.
Well this place I heard some guys talking about San Francisco might have been orion but you've been talking about the alley. Is that the Eclipse alley that George named the band?

No, no. The alley was on St. Bernard and Claiborne. Right behind, that's where the Seminard Market was. And in the back of the Seminard Market they had allies leading from Seminard off to Claiborne. And right in the back there they had a cabaret.
That's what they called the alley.
That's what they called the alley, yeah.
That wasn't in Sturryville at all.
That's why I heard Guy Kelly there. Guy Kelly.
